cohort: Surgically treated patients at Dilla University Referral Hospital in the surgical department.
finding: The magnitude of surgical site infections was 19.3%, and shock, low hemoglobin level (<7g/dL), blood transfusion, previous surgery, and longer length of hospital stay were significantly associated with surgical site infections.
followup_time: 30 days post-surgery, or 1 year for patients with implants
